title: The 10 Best Impact Socket Sets
subtitle: 1/2-inch and 3/8-inch drive impact socket sets, SAE and metric, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: Impact sockets are built to survive the hammering of an impact wrench without cracking. We ranked 10 best-sellers from NEIKO, DEWALT, VEVOR, CASOMAN and value brands on rating, review volume and features (1/2-inch drive, deep and shallow sockets, a case and extensions or adapters).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

reasons: VEVOR sells another 65-piece 1/2-inch set (ranked above) with the same 3/8 to 1-1/4 inch and 10 to 24 mm range for about $4 less.
Its high-torque bullet says the six-point design 'sets it apart from traditional designs lacking rounded corners', which doesn't describe anything specific.
The part number field is a product description, and its review count is shared with VEVOR's 91-piece set, so it's hard to know which set the reviews describe.

buyers_guide.a: Impact sockets are made from tougher, more ductile steel (usually Cr-Mo) with thicker walls and a black finish. Chrome sockets can crack or shatter on an impact wrench.
1/2-inch drive is the standard for lug nuts, suspension and most impact wrenches. 3/8-inch fits smaller impact wrenches and tight spots.
Deep sockets reach nuts on long studs and bolts. Shallow sockets fit where clearance is tight. A set with both covers most jobs.
Six-point impact sockets grip the flats of a fastener and are far less likely to round it off under impact.

buyers_guide.q: Is a ratchet OK on impact sockets?
buyers_guide.a: Yes, impact sockets work with hand ratchets. The reverse isn't true: don't use chrome sockets on an impact wrench.
